name: microaggregation-income-tax
description: Micro-aggregation (MDAV) for privacy-preserving publication of income and tax microdata, with a Streamlit dashboard

paragraphs: A complete, reproducible data-privacy project showing how micro-aggregation (MDAV) can protect sensitive financial records in an income/tax microdata release while preserving statistical utility — and, just as importantly, where it falls short. It includes the algorithm, a release guard, a battery of utility and attack metrics, an interactive Streamlit dashboard and a full report.

Important: micro-aggregation reduces disclosure risk; it does not make data absolutely anonymous. Attribute-disclosure and background-knowledge attacks remain possible and are measured explicitly in this project (see Limitations).
features: MDAV micro-aggregation from scratch (NumPy), k-anonymous on all released attributes, means and total tax revenue preserved exactly.
Two baselines: individual ranking and random partition, to make the privacy–utility trade-off visible.
Release guard: whitelisted columns, shuffled rows, fresh ids, enforced k-anonymity — unsafe releases cannot be exported.
Attack suite: record linkage, interval disclosure, homogeneity / l-diversity / t-closeness, dominance and p%-rules, QI-inference, collusion.
Safe-by-default dashboard: exact original values are hidden unless a custodian toggle is switched on.
